BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 268. SHANGHAI.

Secret + Personal.

24th March 1937.

My dear Bourne,

With reference to my letter of February
22nd 1937., I write to inform you that L. E. BRAYSHAW
was arrested on December 12th 1936 at Bowen, Queensland,
Australia and that steps are being taken to secure his
extradition.

Yours Sincerely,
H. R. Hill

Major E.M. Bourne M.C.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road.

D.C.(G)
（印：mB 25 MAR 1937）

P.A.
（印：〔此处转录不清〕 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
